subject: Your Amazon Prime and Kindle Unlimited renewal receipt
body:
Hi,

This month's charge to your payment method includes two renewals:

- Amazon Prime membership: $139.00 (USD)
- Kindle Unlimited membership: $11.99 (USD)

Total charged: $150.99 (USD).

Your next billing date is September 14, 2027.

- The Amazon Team
_note: Two genuinely distinct subscriptions billed in one email; extraction currently pulls only one signal per email. Guessed it would latch onto the first-listed/larger line item (Amazon Prime, $139.00) over Kindle Unlimited ($11.99), but this is a real guess — either figure, or the combined $150.99 total, is a plausible extraction outcome worth checking against.
